confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge with post-2022 price growth applied; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain, while July peak-season accommodation is least certain. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the beer relationship (cocktail about 3x draft beer, wine glass about 1.2x) because direct knowledge is weaker. EUR prices were converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.16 from memory. The FX value (RBA 4pm, 14 Oct 2026) came from a search summary of the RBA homepage, not a direct page read; the table was reported as garbled and matched by position, and no 15 Oct figure was found, so verify before official use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was copied; the basis is general knowledge of central Lisbon tourist-area prices, loosely benchmarked against Madrid, Barcelona and Porto (Porto as a lower-priced reference).
